title: Route Pickup Fee Rate Card — Northgate Purchases & Returns Business Freight Pickups
content:
Rate card for the route pickup fee on the changed-mind freight pickup of special-order merchandise bought through Northgate Purchases & Returns on a Northgate Business Membership or Northgate Business Plus Membership.

## Rate

The route pickup fee is the channel's changed-mind pickup fee for the trip (the Northgate Special Order changed-mind freight pickup fee in the channel's return fee schedule) plus a per-piece handling charge of 10.00 for every unit on the authorization after the first. The route pickup fee is rounded half up to the cent.

| Element | Basis |
|---|---|
| Trip charge | the channel's changed-mind freight pickup fee, once per trip |
| Piece handling | 10.00 for each unit on the authorization beyond the first |
| Rounding | half up to the cent, once, on the final route pickup fee |

## Which authorization and which units

The authorization is the return authorization awaiting the member's confirmation (recorded as submitted), and the fee is entered against its sale line. The units are the units on that authorization. The first unit carries no handling charge; a single-unit authorization is charged the trip charge alone.

## Worked figures (hypothetical authorizations)

| Units on the authorization | Units after the first | Piece handling | Route pickup fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | 0.00 | the trip charge |
| 2 | 1 | 10.00 | the trip charge plus 10.00 |
| 5 | 4 | 40.00 | the trip charge plus 40.00 |

For a 5-unit authorization the piece handling is 4 units multiplied by 10.00, 40.00, and the route pickup fee is the trip charge plus 40.00, rounded half up to the cent.
